query.query: Paracetamol comparative effectiveness versus placebo meta-analysis

results.text: An indirect comparison of the efficacy and safety of desvenlafaxine and venlafaxine using placebo as the common comparator. This meta-analysis compared the efficacy and safety of desvenlafaxine and venlafaxine at the Australian approved doses.

Various treatments for preventing episodic migraine are available. To evaluate the comparative effectiveness and harms of pharmacologic prevention of episodic migraine, focusing on treatments already determined to be superior to placebo.
